description: Evaluation set for the standing classifier: every page x every brand. Pages are public comparisons and roundups in the GEO tools category that the fetcher can read (the review sites that list FlyRank all block automated access). Fact sheets contain only what each brand's own site stated on as_of.

fact_sheet.pricing_note: Sparrow is the entry plan; prices are 'starting at' per month
sparrow_includes: AI Visibility tracking for up to 100 prompts across ChatGPT, Gemini & Claude
Up to 300 content credits per month
Reddit mention tracking for up to 10 keywords

fact_sheet.enterprise: custom annual pricing; all models (up to 13 LLMs tracked), API access, SSO, daily or weekly tracking
fact_sheet.note: Dollar prices are rendered client-side and were not captured; do not judge price claims as stale

plans.name: Trial
plans.includes: limited AI Marketer credits, 50 prompts run daily for 7 days, ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews

plans.name: Enterprise
